description.zh: 待添加的定时预热任务执行计划列表。
description.en: The list of execution plans to be added for scheduled prefetch tasks.

description.zh: 定时预热计划结束时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）。
description.en: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).

description.zh: 定时预热计划每批执行间隔，单位秒。
description.en: The interval between each batch execution of the scheduled prefetch plan. Unit: seconds.
The number of URLs to prefetch per batch.

description.zh: 定时预热计划开始时间，格式为 ISO 8601（如 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z）。
description.en: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).

description.zh: 预热任务ID，通过调用[CreateScheduledPreloadJob](~~2850459~~)接口生成。
description.en: The prefetch task ID, which is generated by calling the [CreateScheduledPreloadJob](~~2850459~~) operation.

title.zh: 批量新增定时预热任务的计划
title.en: Create execution plans for batch scheduled prefetch tasks

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-scheduled-preload-executions --id 665d3af3621bccf3fe29e1a4 --executions SliceLen=10 EndTime=2024-06-04T02:02:09Z StartTime=2024-06-03T16:00:00Z Interval=30 --region cn-hangzhou
